titleStructures.structure: Why [civilization] was a dangerous place for [task]
Everyday rules that defined life in [civilization]

limitations: Most archaeological evidence relates to elite structures, creating a bias in reconstructed daily life.
Textual records are biased toward the perspective of wealthy Roman authors.
Visual recreations are often interpretations rather than documented facts.
Small-scale household objects often lack provenance, making them difficult to date precisely.
